messages:
ravi: quick follow-up from the streaming-retry RFC review: can frontdoor proactively advertise a per-request "shed score" + a small preempt handshake so clients/runtime decide to hedge or wait?

sophia: ok sketch it out. what fields do you want in the handshake?

ravi: on accept: x-rd-accept-attempt=<attempt-id>; x-rd-shed-score=0..100; x-rd-resume-capable=0/1. later if we near the budget we send a trailer: x-rd-preempt=reason=egress_pressure;resume-window-ms=2000;checkpoint-ref=kv:abcd1234

mike: two concerns: 1) resume semantics need a checksum so resumed output isn't double-counted; 2) holding checkpoints eats memory. we need clear timeout semantics.

yasmin: +1 on checksum. also suggest scoped fence tokens: x-rd-fence=<fence>|<kid>|<hmac> so runtime/edge can validate tenant ownership.

ravi: agreed. resume flow I imagine: client reconnects with same fence; frontdoor maps fence->latest_attempt; if runtime offers resume we attach attempt lineage header and stitch. if checksum matches, client SDK suppresses duplicate token billing.

sophia: billing policy question: if resume fails checksum, do we bill both attempts? my vote: charge emitted tokens for each attempt; if resume checksum matches then only charge new tokens. add small preempt credit to partially refund preempted attempts.

mike: operational tradeoffs: long resume-window -> higher memory and KV retention; short window -> more duplicates and extra compute. we should expose route-level knobs: resume_window_ms, admission=soft|hard, hedge_policy=none|fallback|parallel.

yasmin: UX: SDK should surface preempt events and optionally auto-retry with same fence when resume-capable. default: don't auto-switch to fallback without opt-in.

ravi: observability needs: fence.id, attempt.id, branch.id, shed_score, preempt_count, resume_success_rate, duplicate_tokens. trace span should include preempt->resume lineage.

sophia: security: fence HMAC keys rotate; validate kid and ensure fence is tenant-scoped. runtime should reject resume requests where fence tenant != auth tenant.

mike: implementation spike plan:
- frontdoor: accept fence header, return attempt id + shed-score header, enforce per-conn ms/byte budget, emit preempt trailer and increment metric
- runtime stub: accept resume handshake with checkpoint-ref + checksum, reply resume_ok or resume_reject
- SDK demo: surface preempt event and show auto-resume flow behind flag

yasmin: deploy-bot: canary branch rd/ingress-preempt-hint-spike created. owners: ravi/frontdoor, mike/runtime, sophia/sdk. infra checklist pending.

ravi: thanks all. we'll reconvene Thursday to review spike numbers and memory vs duplicate-work tradeoff. :rocket:
